'''Fuzzy's''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]. In about [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Heroes of Cularin]] found a gambling chip from Fuzzy's inside a conference roon on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]].
